payload.name: Measure and Batch the Judgment Calls We Generate Ourselves
payload.description: Most model calls can come from our own votes and background loops. Before adding a judgment, its share is measured, and many yes or no questions are proposed in one batch and confirmed only where they matter.

principles.name: Volume is a design choice
principles.description: Latency and quota are used up by the judgments the system chooses to make, so the lever is how many it makes.

heuristics.condition: a long job runs inside a pass that gates other work
heuristics.action: give it its own actor so it cannot starve the pass
propose in one call and confirm only the proposed changes

decision_rules.name: Measure first
decision_rules.outcome: count calls by class from the ledger before adding another and state its expected share

decision_rules.name: Propose then confirm
decision_rules.condition: many items need a yes or no
decision_rules.outcome: make one batched call that proposes, then confirm with the strength-N vote only the items proposed for change

decision_rules.name: Own actor for long jobs
decision_rules.condition: a long job would sit inside a gating pass
decision_rules.outcome: run it in its own actor so the other work keeps moving
